title: Shunkei lacquer
summary: Turn a wide tea bowl from pale wood and wipe on coats of clear lac until the golden grain glows through, deepening to amber and red-brown.
howToPlay: The bowl in its frame shows what to make.
Drag across the wood to set its width.
Tap each band to wipe on a clear, amber or red-brown coat.
rules: Shape counts for 70 points and the coat on each band for 30.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn makes a whole piece for you.
heritageNote: Shunkei is a lacquer finish from Takayama in the Hida region. Thin wood is coated with a clear lac tinted yellow, amber or red, so that the pattern of the wood grain shows through the coat like honey.
